race.title: Mucking Brilliant Paddy Power Novices' Chase (Listed) (Registered As The Doctor Fothergill Novices' Chase) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Henry de Bromhead has already tasted success with a novice here this autumn and his KING'S BUCKS may well become another. He shaped well sent chasing after 6 months off when second at Galway 18 days ago and with the sharp test at this trip expected to hold no fears, he could be the answer. Intosomethinggood may emerge next best, ahead of Kingston Narcissus who has stamina to prove up in trip. KING'S BUCKS (FR) INTOSOMETHINGGOOD KINGSTON NARCISSUS (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Derryhassen Paddy (2/1), King's Bucks (2/1), Kingston Narcissus (4/1), Bill Joyce (5/1), Intosomethinggood (5/1), D Art D Art (6/1), Follow Your Luck (8/1)
